ACCELERATION (Q3 2026-Q1 2027) executes pilot deployments and scales training. OPTIMIZATION (Q2-Q4 2027) drives enterprise rollout and embedded continuous improvement.

Q1 2026: 2.18 (Baseline) → Q2 2026: 2.25 → Q3 2026: 2.35 → Q4 2026: 2.42 → Q1 2027: 2.51 → Q2 2027: 2.56 → Q3 2027: 2.60 → Q4 2027: 2.65+
